task.title: Fix Breadcrumb list semantic violation
task.summary_zh: F17 a11y axe serious 中 list + listitem 違規：Breadcrumb 元件用 <ol> 直接含 <li class=contents>，render 結果 ol 直接帶 span，違反 list 結構規則（cat.structure / wcag131）。實際 HTML：<ol class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 break-words text-sm text-muted-foreground sm:gap-2.5"> 內含 li.inline-flex 但 li 是 'display: contents'，造成 li 的 child span 變成 ol 的直接 child。修：(1) 不要用 li.contents（破壞 list 語意）；(2) 改 Breadcrumb 結構讓 <li> 真實是 ol 直接 child；(3) 或不用 ol/li，改用 <nav aria-label="breadcrumb">+<ol>+<li> 但去掉 contents class。修完後 axe list/listitem 規則無 violation。Evidence: execute-plans/.lovable/audits/baseline/postfix/pantheon-integration-evidence/test-results/ 17-a11y-v5-*on-control-room*/error-context.md 內含 'List element has direct children that are not allowed: span'
acceptance: Breadcrumb 在所有 v5 頁面 axe list/listitem 規則 0 violation

handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by idle Claude; previous owner Codex2 becomes reviewer.

Breadcrumb list semantic violation fixed. Root cause was PageHeader.tsx using <span className='contents'> as keyed map wrapper (commit 6feed7f), making span a direct child of <ol> and breaking list/listitem axe rules. Fix: dd411e2 replaced span.contents with <Fragment key={node.path}>, ensuring all <li> elements are direct children of <ol>. Task commit b0dc126 in execute-plans (bff-luv-fe-006-dev-deploy): fixes BreadcrumbEllipsis.displayName typo. Verification: tsc --noEmit exit 0, vite build exit 0. nav aria-label=breadcrumb preserved. Acceptance: ol has no direct span children; all li are direct ol children via transparent Fragment. Ready for review.
Review approved. Evidence: support/reviews/FE-INT-GATE-A11Y-BREADCRUMB-codex2-review.md. Owner should finalize with task-scoped closeout commit and done transition.
